judge.notes: The agent was polite, strictly followed the passenger's mandate to reject the voucher, and successfully secured a full cash refund.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Leila. I can confirm your booking reference F8JX4R for flight FZ433. Your flight has been cancelled due to schedule optimisation. Would you like a voucher with 10% extra value or a refund to your original card?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'd like to decline the voucher, please. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, I'm entitled to a full refund to the original payment method, and that's what I'm requesting on behalf of the passenger.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger cannot accept a voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, the passenger is entitled to a full refund to the original payment method. Could you please process that instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Leila. I'll process a full refund to your original payment method immediately. Your reference number is H 9 7 L K P.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Priya. Just to confirm, the reference number is Hotel Nine Seven Lima Kilo Papa. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on their end?
